title: 河床固床工設計
subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection
summary: 固床工會改變水面、河床及泥砂通量，並非把河床固定後便完成任務。十個單元連結落差配置、臨界水深、水躍、揚壓、顆粒起動、濾層與上下游地形反應，讓學員分辨幾何可行、結構穩定與河道長期平衡三種不同檢核。
summaryEn: Grade control changes water levels, bed elevations and sediment fluxes. Ten units connect drop spacing, critical depth, hydraulic jumps, uplift, grain motion, filters and channel response. Learners distinguish geometric feasibility, structural resistance and long term channel adjustment, and examine how protecting one location may transfer erosion or sedimentation to another reach.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「落差配置與縱坡」與「斷面比能的兩種流態」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drop spacing and longitudinal slope" and "Specific energy and alternate depths": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 落差配置與縱坡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drop spacing and longitudinal slope: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「落差配置與縱坡」如何影響河床固床工設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drop spacing and longitudinal slope” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Riverbed grade-control structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 固床工把河段總落差分配到構造物與其間河床，先用幾何關係可以檢查配置是否自洽。原坡與目標坡的差值乘以間距，才是單一落差需要承擔的高程差，並非河段全部天然落差。目標坡還受輸砂、河寬與下游控制影響，不能僅為縮短施工量而任意選定。配置圖須同時標出支流匯入、橋梁與魚類通行位置，因為相同總落差的不同分配會產生不同局部影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「落差配置與縱坡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grade control distributes total reach fall between structures and intervening bed. A geometric balance checks consistency: the difference between existing and target slope, multiplied by spacing, gives the drop assigned to one structure. Target slope also depends on sediment supply, width and downstream control, so it cannot be chosen solely to reduce construction. Map tributaries, bridges and passage routes because different distributions of identical total fall create different local consequences. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drop spacing and longitudinal slope” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「由坡差算出的間距就是所有流量下的最適構造物間距」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Spacing derived from slope difference is optimal at every discharge" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「落差配置與縱坡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drop spacing and longitudinal slope”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 落差配置與縱坡
knowledge.text: 固床工把河段總落差分配到構造物與其間河床，先用幾何關係可以檢查配置是否自洽。原坡與目標坡的差值乘以間距，才是單一落差需要承擔的高程差，並非河段全部天然落差。
knowledge.textEn: Grade control distributes total reach fall between structures and intervening bed. A geometric balance checks consistency: the difference between existing and target slope, multiplied by spacing, gives the drop assigned to one structure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：由坡差算出的間距就是所有流量下的最適構造物間距 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Spacing derived from slope difference is optimal at every discharge Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「河床固床工設計」的「落差配置與縱坡：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出流域、入流、儲存、出流與下游的水量邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「洪水量測與河道模型」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的流量、水位、截面與儀器校正紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Drop spacing and longitudinal slope: mechanism and system paths” in “Riverbed grade-control structures”. Draw the catchment, inflow, storage, outflow and downstream water balance; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Flood gauging and river model” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for flow, level, section and calibration records for the same time window, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「落差配置與縱坡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drop spacing and longitudinal slope" is correct?
options: 由坡差算出的間距就是所有流量下的最適構造物間距
固床工把河段總落差分配到構造物與其間河床，先用幾何關係可以檢查配置是否自洽。
不同床高斷面的比能可直接相減當作全部水頭損失
optionsEn: Spacing derived from slope difference is optimal at every discharge
Grade control distributes total reach fall between structures and intervening bed.
Specific energies at different bed elevations directly give total head loss
quiz.explanation: 固床工把河段總落差分配到構造物與其間河床，先用幾何關係可以檢查配置是否自洽。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Grade control distributes total reach fall between structures and intervening bed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 落差配置與縱坡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drop spacing and longitudinal slope: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「落差配置與縱坡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drop spacing and longitudinal slope” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m。適用邊界：均一坡度的幾何初估，不是最適間距或平衡坡保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m. Applicable boundary: Geometric screening with uniform slopes, not an optimal spacing or guarantee of equilibrium. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一高程基準重測河床縱斷面，分辨局部沙洲頂與深槽底，核對相鄰構造物之間的總落差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Resurvey the bed profile on one datum, distinguishing bar crests from the thalweg, and check total fall between structures.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m。適用邊界：均一坡度的幾何初估，不是最適間距或平衡坡保證。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m. Applicable boundary: Geometric screening with uniform slopes, not an optimal spacing or guarantee of equilibrium.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「落差配置與縱坡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drop spacing and longitudinal slope", which statement holds?
options: 共軛水深算正確就同時證明消能池長度足夠
同一個希爾茲臨界值適用所有粒徑混合與黏性河床
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m。
optionsEn: A correct conjugate-depth calculation also proves that the stilling basin is long enough
One critical Shields value applies to every grain mixture and cohesive riverbed
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: dz=0.6 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 落差配置與縱坡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drop spacing and longitudinal slope: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「落差配置與縱坡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drop spacing and longitudinal slope” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一高程基準重測河床縱斷面，分辨局部沙洲頂與深槽底，核對相鄰構造物之間的總落差。將支流出口與洪水水面另畫，若存在回水控制，應進行水面與泥砂分析後再修正幾何配置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Resurvey the bed profile on one datum, distinguishing bar crests from the thalweg, and check total fall between structures. Plot tributary outlets and flood levels separately; backwater control requires hydraulic and sediment analysis before adopting geometric spacing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將目標坡改成千分之六重算間距，說明為何落差較少分配給河床時構造密度會改變。畫出末端下切時的可能傳遞路徑，列出必要調查點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Set target slope to six per thousand and recompute spacing. Explain the changed distribution of fall, then sketch how terminal incision could propagate and identify the survey points needed to test that sequence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：間距雖符合幾何式，若下游河床持續下降，末端構造仍可能被淘空並引發逐級失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Geometrically consistent spacing can still fail when downstream incision undermines the terminal structure and progresses upstream. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同一高程基準重測河床縱斷面，分辨局部沙洲頂與深槽底，核對相鄰構造物之間的總落差。將支流出口與洪水水面另畫，若存在回水控制，應進行水面與泥砂分析後再修正幾何配置。
knowledge.textEn: Resurvey the bed profile on one datum, distinguishing bar crests from the thalweg, and check total fall between structures. Plot tributary outlets and flood levels separately; backwater control requires hydraulic and sediment analysis before adopting geometric spacing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將目標坡改成千分之六重算間距，說明為何落差較少分配給河床時構造密度會改變。畫出末端下切時的可能傳遞路徑，列出必要調查點。
knowledge.textEn: Set target slope to six per thousand and recompute spacing. Explain the changed distribution of fall, then sketch how terminal incision could propagate and identify the survey points needed to test that sequence.

quiz.question: 要驗證「落差配置與縱坡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drop spacing and longitudinal slope"?
options: 以同一高程基準重測河床縱斷面，分辨局部沙洲頂與深槽底，核對相鄰構造物之間的總落差。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
平均床高下降量必然等於每個位置的實際沖刷深度
optionsEn: Resurvey the bed profile on one datum, distinguishing bar crests from the thalweg, and check total fall between structures.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Mean bed lowering necessarily equals the actual scour depth at every location
quiz.explanation: 以同一高程基準重測河床縱斷面，分辨局部沙洲頂與深槽底，核對相鄰構造物之間的總落差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Resurvey the bed profile on one datum, distinguishing bar crests from the thalweg, and check total fall between structures. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 落差配置與縱坡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drop spacing and longitudinal slope: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「落差配置與縱坡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drop spacing and longitudinal slope” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 間距雖符合幾何式，若下游河床持續下降，末端構造仍可能被淘空並引發逐級失效。診斷應從下游控制與供砂變化回查，而非只補高上游堰頂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Geometrically consistent spacing can still fail when downstream incision undermines the terminal structure and progresses upstream. Investigate downstream control and sediment supply before simply raising upstream crests to restore the profile. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：配置圖須同時標出支流匯入、橋梁與魚類通行位置，因為相同總落差的不同分配會產生不同局部影響。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Map tributaries, bridges and passage routes because different distributions of identical total fall create different local consequences.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「由坡差算出的間距就是所有流量下的最適構造物間距」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Spacing derived from slope difference is optimal at every discharge" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 間距雖符合幾何式，若下游河床持續下降，末端構造仍可能被淘空並引發逐級失效。診斷應從下游控制與供砂變化回查，而非只補高上游堰頂。
knowledge.textEn: Geometrically consistent spacing can still fail when downstream incision undermines the terminal structure and progresses upstream. Investigate downstream control and sediment supply before simply raising upstream crests to restore the profile.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「落差配置與縱坡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drop spacing and longitudinal slope" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
間距雖符合幾何式，若下游河床持續下降，末端構造仍可能被淘空並引發逐級失效。
不同床高斷面的比能可直接相減當作全部水頭損失
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Geometrically consistent spacing can still fail when downstream incision undermines the terminal structure and progresses upstream.
Specific energies at different bed elevations directly give total head loss
quiz.explanation: 間距雖符合幾何式，若下游河床持續下降，末端構造仍可能被淘空並引發逐級失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Geometrically consistent spacing can still fail when downstream incision undermines the terminal structure and progresses upstream. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 斷面比能的兩種流態：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Specific energy and alternate depths: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「斷面比能的兩種流態」如何影響河床固床工設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Specific energy and alternate depths” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Riverbed grade-control structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 比能以局部河床為基準，把水深與速度水頭合在一起，適合辨認落差上游是否接近控制斷面。矩形河道的單寬流量固定時，同一比能可能對應深慢與淺快兩種水深解；臨界點則是比能最低位置。這裡所稱兩種解不是可任意互換的現場狀態，還要符合上下游邊界和能量損失。河床高程若改變，總水頭必須另加高程，不能直接比較不同斷面的比能數字。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「斷面比能的兩種流態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Specific energy combines depth and velocity head relative to the local bed. At fixed unit discharge in a rectangular channel, one energy level can correspond to a deep slow or shallow fast depth, while the minimum defines critical flow. These alternate depths are not freely interchangeable field states; boundary conditions and losses select the actual solution. When bed elevation changes, include elevation in total head rather than comparing specific energy values from different sections directly. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Specific energy and alternate depths” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不同床高斷面的比能可直接相減當作全部水頭損失」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Specific energies at different bed elevations directly give total head loss" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「斷面比能的兩種流態」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Specific energy and alternate depths”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 斷面比能的兩種流態
knowledge.text: 比能以局部河床為基準，把水深與速度水頭合在一起，適合辨認落差上游是否接近控制斷面。矩形河道的單寬流量固定時，同一比能可能對應深慢與淺快兩種水深解；臨界點則是比能最低位置。
knowledge.textEn: Specific energy combines depth and velocity head relative to the local bed. At fixed unit discharge in a rectangular channel, one energy level can correspond to a deep slow or shallow fast depth, while the minimum defines critical flow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：不同床高斷面的比能可直接相減當作全部水頭損失 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Specific energies at different bed elevations directly give total head loss Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斷面比能的兩種流態」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Specific energy and alternate depths" is correct?
options: 不同床高斷面的比能可直接相減當作全部水頭損失
臨界水深只由單寬流量決定所以尾水永遠不影響構造出流
比能以局部河床為基準，把水深與速度水頭合在一起，適合辨認落差上游是否接近控制斷面。
optionsEn: Specific energies at different bed elevations directly give total head loss
Because critical depth depends on unit discharge, tailwater never affects structure discharge
Specific energy combines depth and velocity head relative to the local bed.
quiz.explanation: 比能以局部河床為基準，把水深與速度水頭合在一起，適合辨認落差上游是否接近控制斷面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Specific energy combines depth and velocity head relative to the local bed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 斷面比能的兩種流態：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Specific energy and alternate depths: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斷面比能的兩種流態」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Specific energy and alternate depths” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m。適用邊界：矩形斷面、速度分布係數取一且近似靜水壓，未包含局部損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m. Applicable boundary: Rectangular section with unit velocity correction and approximately hydrostatic pressure, excluding local losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量水深與斷面流量後以多點速度確認分布是否均勻，再將實測點放在比能曲線上。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure depth and discharge, check velocity distribution at several points, and place observations on a specific-energy curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m。適用邊界：矩形斷面、速度分布係數取一且近似靜水壓，未包含局部損失。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m. Applicable boundary: Rectangular section with unit velocity correction and approximately hydrostatic pressure, excluding local losses.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「斷面比能的兩種流態」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Specific energy and alternate depths", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m。
護坦下方有排水孔就可以在所有工況忽略揚壓
任一濾料與基土的粒徑比等於四就保證濾層安全
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m.
Drain holes beneath an apron allow uplift to be ignored in every condition
Any filter to base-soil grading ratio of four guarantees filter safety
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 斷面比能的兩種流態：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Specific energy and alternate depths: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斷面比能的兩種流態」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Specific energy and alternate depths” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量水深與斷面流量後以多點速度確認分布是否均勻，再將實測點放在比能曲線上。不同測站需加回各自床高才能比較總水頭，若發現表面落差卻無對應能損，先核對基準與量測位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure depth and discharge, check velocity distribution at several points, and place observations on a specific-energy curve. Add bed elevation at each station before comparing total head. Apparent inconsistencies require checks of datum and measurement location before interpreting losses. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持單寬流量不變，另算一個較深水深的比能並畫在曲線上。把兩斷面床高也列入帳表，說明哪些組合需要能量輸入才可能成立。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep unit discharge fixed and calculate specific energy at a greater depth. Plot both points and add bed elevations in a head ledger, explaining which combinations would require an external energy input.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在強烈垂直加速度的跌水口直接使用靜水壓比能，可能錯估控制水深。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying a hydrostatic expression within a rapidly curving nappe can misrepresent control depth. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量水深與斷面流量後以多點速度確認分布是否均勻，再將實測點放在比能曲線上。不同測站需加回各自床高才能比較總水頭，若發現表面落差卻無對應能損，先核對基準與量測位置。
knowledge.textEn: Measure depth and discharge, check velocity distribution at several points, and place observations on a specific-energy curve. Add bed elevation at each station before comparing total head. Apparent inconsistencies require checks of datum and measurement location before interpreting losses.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持單寬流量不變，另算一個較深水深的比能並畫在曲線上。把兩斷面床高也列入帳表，說明哪些組合需要能量輸入才可能成立。
knowledge.textEn: Keep unit discharge fixed and calculate specific energy at a greater depth. Plot both points and add bed elevations in a head ledger, explaining which combinations would require an external energy input.

quiz.question: 要驗證「斷面比能的兩種流態」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Specific energy and alternate depths"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
量水深與斷面流量後以多點速度確認分布是否均勻，再將實測點放在比能曲線上。
只要乾燥重量相同不同形狀石塊就具有相同抗移動能力
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Measure depth and discharge, check velocity distribution at several points, and place observations on a specific-energy curve.
Stones with equal dry weight have identical movement resistance regardless of shape
quiz.explanation: 量水深與斷面流量後以多點速度確認分布是否均勻，再將實測點放在比能曲線上。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure depth and discharge, check velocity distribution at several points, and place observations on a specific-energy curve. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 斷面比能的兩種流態：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Specific energy and alternate depths: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斷面比能的兩種流態」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Specific energy and alternate depths” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在強烈垂直加速度的跌水口直接使用靜水壓比能，可能錯估控制水深。應移到壓力分布較合理的斷面，或改用能描述非靜水效應的模型。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying a hydrostatic expression within a rapidly curving nappe can misrepresent control depth. Move the section to a suitable location or use a model resolving nonhydrostatic pressure and vertical acceleration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：河床高程若改變，總水頭必須另加高程，不能直接比較不同斷面的比能數字。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: When bed elevation changes, include elevation in total head rather than comparing specific energy values from different sections directly.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不同床高斷面的比能可直接相減當作全部水頭損失」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Specific energies at different bed elevations directly give total head loss" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在強烈垂直加速度的跌水口直接使用靜水壓比能，可能錯估控制水深。應移到壓力分布較合理的斷面，或改用能描述非靜水效應的模型。
knowledge.textEn: Applying a hydrostatic expression within a rapidly curving nappe can misrepresent control depth. Move the section to a suitable location or use a model resolving nonhydrostatic pressure and vertical acceleration.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「斷面比能的兩種流態」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Specific energy and alternate depths" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
臨界水深只由單寬流量決定所以尾水永遠不影響構造出流
在強烈垂直加速度的跌水口直接使用靜水壓比能，可能錯估控制水深。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Because critical depth depends on unit discharge, tailwater never affects structure discharge
Applying a hydrostatic expression within a rapidly curving nappe can misrepresent control depth.
quiz.explanation: 在強烈垂直加速度的跌水口直接使用靜水壓比能，可能錯估控制水深。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Applying a hydrostatic expression within a rapidly curving nappe can misrepresent control depth. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
